title: Signed order of repeated clinic blood pressure does not improve cross-cycle renal-marker prediction
abstract: Signed within-visit BP decline did not improve transferred log-UACR prediction: weighted MSE 0.804745 to 0.812233 (delta +0.007488; joint PSU bootstrap95% [0.002700,0.793400]). Exploratory independently sampled NHANES-cycle transfer, not untouched confirmation or external-health-system validation.
